spanish: Y harás cincuenta ganchos de oro, y juntarás las cortinas mujer a su hermana en los ganchos, y será el mishkán uno.

findings.issue: Common noun הַמִּשְׁכָּן is left as the untranslated lemma mishkán; a common noun must be Spanish.
The preposition ב is only marked as a preposition; en selects a locative sense where with/by remains open.

notes: Remaining clauses match person, number, construct, article, and the woman-to-her-sister wording.
